acip: MDO GANG LAS GZUGS SOGS RNAMS KYANG BDAG YIN PA BKAG PA DE LAS NI, BRTEN NAS BTAGS PA'I BDAG 'JIG LTA'I DMIGS PA 'DIS PHUNG PO LEN PA'I PHUNG PO'I NYE BAR LEN PA CAN RANG BZHIN GYIS GRUB PA BKAG PAR RIG PAR BYA STE, GZUGS SOGS BDAG MIN PAR GSUNGS PA DE NI DE KHO NA NYID LA SEMS PA'I SKABS YIN PA'I PHYIR RO,,
wylie: mdo gang las gzugs sogs rnams kyang bdag yin pa bkag pa de las ni, brten nas btags pa'i bdag 'jig lta'i dmigs pa 'dis phung po len pa'i phung po'i nye bar len pa can rang bzhin gyis grub pa bkag par rig par bya ste, gzugs sogs bdag min par gsungs pa de ni de kho na nyid la sems pa'i skabs yin pa'i phyir ro
english: There are other sutras in which it is also denied that form and the rest could be the self; and from this we should understand that the self as labeled in dependence—what it is that the view of destruction focuses upon—serves to deny the idea that the one it is that takes on the parts to the person as these parts are taken could exist through any nature of its own. That is, statements that form and the rest are not the self are made in the context of considering the topic of suchness.
